messages:
amy-devex: quick heads-up from the new onboarding sample app: noticed the SDK retries a POST after a 307 redirect but the request body is a streaming one-shot. on some emulators this results in the retried POST being sent with an empty body and the server returning 400.

amy-devex: repro in sample-app (Android emulator API 30): sequence is POST -> 307 redirect -> SDK follows redirect and retries automatically -> server sees empty body.

rafael-android: interesting. do we replay the request body on retry? Retrofit/OkHttp only replays bodies if they are buffered or of type RequestBody that supports repeatable writes. streaming bodies are not repeatable.

emily-qa: logs?

amy-devex: minimal logs + snippet: 
```
I/SDK: --> POST /v1/upload (streaming body)
I/Server: <-- 307 /new-upload
I/SDK: following redirect and retrying POST
I/SDK: --> POST /new-upload (retry)
I/Server: <-- 400 (empty body)
```
Snippet from sample app: 
```
val body = object : RequestBody() {
  override fun contentType() = "application/octet-stream".toMediaType()
  override fun writeTo(sink: BufferedSink) {
    // stream from InputStream that is only readable once
    copy(inputStream, sink.outputStream())
  }
}
api.upload(body)
```

rafael-android: Eh. OkHttp's followRedirects will create a new request but it won't replay non-repeatable bodies. Usually servers respond to 307 expecting client to resend body, but client libraries can't always do that. Some platforms buffer automatically for small payloads, but not for streams. Why is SDK auto-following 307 for POSTs? 307 should preserve method and body but for streaming bodies we can't.

amy-devex: SDK default policy is follow redirects; we didn't special-case 307 on POSTs. The sample app triggered a redirect because dev env uses a gateway that issues 307 for path rewrite. In production we rarely see it, but for onboarding it's common.

emily-qa: flaky reproduction? can we make a test that simulates a 307 and verifies body replay or a clear error?

rafael-android: two options: (1) change default to not auto-follow 307 for non-repeatable bodies and surface redirect to caller (2) buffer small streaming bodies into a repeatable ByteString when size < threshold and allow redirect + replay. (3) detect redirect + non-repeatable and fail early with structured error telling user to use a repeatable body or disable followRedirects.

amy-devex: preference: (3) is least surprising for users during onboarding; surface explicit error so sample app can either disable followRedirects or buffer the body. We should document the tradeoff in the SDK docs.

rafael-android: implementable: in our OkHttp EventListener/Interceptor we can check response.isRedirect && originalRequest.body != null && !isRepeatable(originalRequest.body) then if followRedirects true, short-circuit and return a 4xx-style SDK error explaining non-repeatable body on redirect. Alternatively, store a flag and set request.followRedirects = false for that call. But OkHttp doesn't let you change followRedirects per-request easily; it's client-level. We could detect and throw.

emily-qa: I'll add a unit + emulator test: simulate streaming body, server returns 307 then see what the SDK surfaces. Test should assert we either get explicit error or that the retry contains equivalent body. We'll run against emulator API 28-33 to catch any platform differences.

amy-devex: also worth noting that some HTTP stacks on older emulators buffer automatically which masked this bug in CI. so we need to ensure tests run on a matrix rather than single runner.

doc-bot: doc-suggestion: add note in "Uploads and streaming" section: "If your request body is a one-shot stream, do not rely on automatic redirect replay. Either set a buffered RequestBody, disable followRedirects in client config, or ensure gateway returns 308 or handle redirect client-side." I'll draft a paragraph.

rafael-android: action items: (1) change SDK to detect redirect+non-repeatable-body and return clear error (PR) (2) update sample app to either buffer small files or disable followRedirects in dev onboarding (3) add emulator matrix flaky test that hits the gateway 307 flow (4) docs update with examples for Kotlin/Java showing how to create repeatable bodies.

amy-devex: agree. i'll open an issue and a small PR for the error path. linking test infra job once queued.

emily-qa: queued job: emulator-redirect-streaming (id 13421).

rafael-android: small snippet for docs showing a buffered alternative: 
```
val bytes = inputStream.readBytes()
val body = bytes.toRequestBody("application/octet-stream".toMediaType())
api.upload(body)
```

amy-devex: thanks. filing: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-kotlin/issues/1920 with description and sample-app fix PR incoming.

doc-bot: added docs TODO: "Uploads: redirect behavior and non-repeatable bodies".

emily-qa: will report test matrix status in the PR before merge.

rafael-android: nice catch, this would have caused subtle data-loss in onboarding. good to make the failure visible rather than silently retrying empty body.

amy-devex: thanks all, I'll follow up with PR link. :thumbsup:
